verdict.rationale: Jina Reader exposes a simple HTTP API (r.jina.ai) with extensive documented options (headers like x-respond-with, x-preset, x-json-schema, x-markdown-chunking) and even a preset for AI research agents, plus an official MCP server for agentic integration. Some community reports show auth/404 friction and no formal OpenAPI spec was found, slightly reducing polish but not the core API-driven design.
